title: Reject an empty sku
body:
## What
Reject an empty sku in `SkuFormatter.Normalize`.

## Why
An empty sku reached the stock queries as an empty text.

## Changes
- **SkuFormatter**: `Normalize` throws an `ArgumentException` for an empty sku and for a sku of white space only.
- **Tests**: `SkuFormatterTests` covers both inputs.

Task: https://github.com/example-org/inventory/issues/822
